title: A member who renews after a long break gets 'We haven't seen you for 60 days' the next morning
what: The phone's own gym reminders count days away from the last check-in, as long as any plan is running now. A member whose last visit was before an old plan ran out, and who renews at the desk weeks later, has a new plan running and a last visit far back, so the next 9:30 am reminder says the gym has not seen them for 60 or more days, the day after they paid. The admin app learned to count from the new plan's start for its own 'not seen' list; the phone did not.
expected: Days away are counted from the later of the last check-in and the start of the plan running now, so a member who just renewed is not told they have been missing.
how_often: whenever a member renews after a break without checking in that day
fix_line: Start counting days away from the current plan's first day when the last check-in is older

items.reason: Plan end and days left: card, Workout-tab card and phone reminders share one 7-day window; panel follows the chain of plans, so a gap renewal or a training pack differ (existing findings). Birthday on 29 Feb is the same on phone and panel. Member app shows no dues total, only the fee requests. Crispy Curves holds 3 members, 2 plans and 2 visits (plain count), so a recount proves little; the ugly data pack is not among the inputs, so the comparison is by code
every difference found already has a finding; reused

Edges tried by code: day 0 ('Ends today'), a plan that starts later ('Starts ...'), no visit yet (no away reminder), joined today (welcome counts today), gap of weeks (away reminder counts from before the break; gap renewal)

Bell count is worked out from the same inbox list; the offer dots come from the gym count with the cap; the trainer weeks are built from the same rows as the exercises. No summary here falls without its rows falling too
Message-your-gym red count (member_talk_unread) and its list (member_talk_list) are two server functions; trainer weekly summary and recent workouts are two phone functions
Long gap: both talk functions use the same 180 days and a new reply puts its thread at the top of the 20 shown; both trainer functions start at the same day joined, so they agree
